think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., 0, -1) that change the knob’s behavior qualitatively (disable/auto/meaning changes), rather than just scaling a quantity. 3) Determine whether setting that value switches the feature off/on or changes mode, versus simply setting a numeric threshold. 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
